standard_prerequisites.name: Taking stalks commutes with sheafification
standard_prerequisites.use: Bridges the presheaf computation to the sheaf tensor product, which is the sheafification of the presheaf tensor product.

core_obligations: The sheaf tensor product F tensor_O O' is by definition the sheafification of the presheaf tensor product F tensor_p,O O' (background of the section). Taking stalks commutes with sheafification (proof lines 2181-2182), so (F tensor_O O')_x = (F tensor_p,O O')_x. The presheaf tensor stalk is computed by the cited lemma as F_x tensor_{O_x} O'_x (proof lines 2180-2182). Chaining gives the asserted equality of O'_x-modules (proof lines 2179-2182).
proof_roadmap: Identify the sheaf tensor product with the sheafification of the presheaf tensor product (background).
Commute the stalk past the sheafification and apply the presheaf computation (proof lines 2180-2182).
